story_updates.headline: What can the equipment losses tell us about the war between Russia and Ukraine?

story_updates.headline: UAE suspends all trade and financial ties with Iran after renewed missile fire
story_updates.summary: The UAE announced it is suspending trade and financial transactions with Iran after its Defense Ministry detected two Iranian ballistic missiles, one landing inside UAE territorial waters, triggering nationwide shelter warnings. Iran denies launching the missiles.

story_updates.headline: Trump administration asked FIFA to replace Iran with Italy at the World Cup
story_updates.summary: The US administration lobbies FIFA to swap Iran for Italy (which failed to qualify) at the upcoming tournament — geopolitics colliding with the World Cup before a ball is kicked.

story_updates.headline: World Cup 2026 group stage under way
story_updates.summary: Early results: Canada 1-1 Bosnia and Herzegovina; USA beat Paraguay 4-1 the following night.

story_updates.headline: USA, Mexico and Germany are first teams into the knockout phase
story_updates.summary: Germany beat Ivory Coast 2-1; Turkey become the first team eliminated after losing 1-0 to Paraguay.

story_updates.headline: Shock in the groups: Ecuador beat Germany 2-1, eliminating them
story_updates.summary: Germany go out in the group stage despite qualifying early for the knockouts being expected; Brazil, Morocco and South Africa advance the same week.

story_updates.headline: Round-of-16 bracket set; Messi leads scorers with 6 goals
story_updates.summary: 16-team knockout bracket announced across 16 host cities; Messi tops the golden-boot standings after the group stage ahead of Mbappe.

story_updates.headline: Argentina come back from 2-0 down to beat Egypt 3-2 in injury time
story_updates.summary: Quarter-final fixtures set: France-Morocco, Spain-Belgium, Norway-England, Argentina-Switzerland. Messi on 8 goals leads scorers.

story_updates.headline: France beat Morocco 2-0 to reach the semi-finals
story_updates.summary: Goals from Mbappe and Dembele send France through.

story_updates.headline: England beat Norway in extra time to reach the semi-finals
story_updates.summary: England come from behind twice, taking the tie to extra time before winning it.

story_updates.headline: Argentina beat Switzerland to set up a semi-final against England
story_updates.summary: Argentina win in extra time; the semi-final lineup is France-Spain and Argentina-England.

story_updates.headline: Spain beat France to become the first team into the World Cup final
story_updates.summary: Spain lead 2-0 through the second half and hold on to reach the final, where they await the winner of Argentina vs England.

story_updates.headline: Spain beats Argentina 1-0 in extra time to win 2026 World Cup final
story_updates.summary: Spain won the 2026 FIFA World Cup, defeating Lionel Messi's Argentina 1-0 on a substitute Ferran Torres extra-time goal at New York New Jersey Stadium in front of more than 80,000 fans. It is Spain's second World Cup title, after 2010.

story_updates.headline: Analysis: corruption scandals undermining Ukraine more than Russian attacks
story_updates.summary: Six months after Operation Midas exposed the $100M Energoatom kickback scheme, the political damage keeps widening — with Mindich in Israel and ex-ministers Chernyshov and Halushchenko among nine charged.

story_updates.headline: NABU charges ex-presidential chief of staff Andriy Yermak with money laundering
story_updates.summary: NABU/SAPO allege over 460M hryvnias (~$8.9M) was funneled through shell companies, cash transactions and fictitious documents into the luxury 'Dynasty' residential complex in Kozyn outside Kyiv — the highest-profile charge of Zelensky's tenure.

story_updates.headline: Yermak appears before the High Anti-Corruption Court; bail set at 180M hryvnias
story_updates.summary: The court opens hearings on a detention motion in the ~$10.5M laundering case; bail is set at almost €3.5M. Properties in the scheme are linked to Mindich, Chernyshov, and individuals identified by media as Yermak and Zelensky.

story_updates.headline: Yermak probe framed as a test for Ukraine and a dilemma for Zelensky
story_updates.summary: Western coverage casts the case as a test of Ukraine's anti-corruption institutions — the same ones Zelensky tried to subordinate via Law 12414 last summer before protests forced a repeal.

story_updates.headline: Yermak taken into pre-trial detention after three-day hearing
story_updates.summary: After a three-day hearing in Kyiv, Yermak is detained on money-laundering charges; he says he cannot pay the ~$3.2M bail.

story_updates.headline: While under NABU suspicion, Yermak co-founds law firm 'Edvox' in Vinnytsia
story_updates.summary: A new legal entity is registered in Vinnytsia with Yermak listed as co-founder — a sign he is rebuilding a private career while the case proceeds.

story_updates.headline: Ex-Energoatom security official named suspect in $674K laundering case
story_updates.summary: NABU named a former Energoatom executive responsible for physical protection and security of nuclear facilities as a suspect, accused of laundering more than 30 million hryvnias ($674,000) between 2023 and 2025, as the 'Midas' investigation continues to expand within the state nuclear operator.

story_updates.headline: Zelensky taps new defence chief as inner-circle turmoil deepens
story_updates.summary: Amid the political crisis that has forced Zelensky to swap several top 'managers' since Operation Midas and the Yermak case, parliament moves to elect a reshaped government; Rustem Umerov is shifted to secretary of the National Security and Defence Council.

story_updates.headline: Zelensky fires commander-in-chief Syrskii and reshuffles defence leadership after protests
story_updates.summary: After six days of rare wartime protests in Kyiv over the ouster of defence minister Mykhailo Fedorov, Zelensky dismisses commander-in-chief Oleksandr Syrskii, names Mykhailo Drapatyi to lead the military, and brings back a former defence minister — the latest churn in a leadership shaken by the Operation Midas corruption fallout.

story_updates.headline: Appeals court upholds seizure of Yermak's property in Dynasty case
story_updates.summary: The Appeals Chamber of Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court rejected the defense's appeal and upheld the May 15 ruling seizing former chief of staff Andriy Yermak's property, part of the Operation Midas money-laundering probe tied to the 'Dynasty' elite residential complex near Kyiv.

story_updates.headline: Russian missiles struck the 'Armada' arms exhibition at a shooting range in Kapitanovka, Kyiv Oblast, killing 10 and injuring ~100, a day...
story_updates.summary: Russian missiles struck the 'Armada' arms exhibition at a shooting range in Kapitanovka, Kyiv Oblast, killing 10 and injuring ~100, a day...

story_updates.headline: Anti-corruption court eases Yermak's travel restrictions
story_updates.summary: Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court partially granted a defense motion, allowing former presidential chief of staff Andriy Yermak to travel outside Kyiv and Kyiv region to Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Zaporizhia, Mykolaiv, Sumy, Kharkiv and Kherson regions without prior permission, easing a restriction imposed after his money-laundering suspicion in the Dynasty case.

story_updates.summary: PM Modi, Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh and JP Nadda attended an NDA Parliamentary Party meeting at the Parliament Library Building, called after Modi met President Murmu and Shah phoned her, fueling speculation the government is planning a major move. Modi separately hosted a breakfast with 37 BJP MPs, including former AAP leaders now in the party, for informal discussion during the monsoon session.

story_updates.summary: A satirical, internet-driven Gen Z protest movement in India, the Cockroach Janta Party, forced the resignation of a top Modi adviser after outrage over corruption, unemployment and the education system, prompting increased censorship and crackdowns on dissent from Modi's government.

story_updates.summary: The BJP named a new slate of national party leaders, including Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal as national treasurer, as the party gears up for crucial state elections including in Uttar Pradesh.

story_updates.headline: NASA's Big Mistake: Choosing Risky Tech Over Reliable Systems
story_updates.summary: The recent explosion of Blue Origin’s New Glenn rocket has dealt a major blow to NASA’s Artemis programme. With Blue Origin’s lunar landers now delayed for potentially years, NASA is left almost entirely dependent on SpaceX and Starship to return humans to the Moon. In this video, I examine why NASA’s current approach, backing high-performance but risky technologies, may be putting its Moon base a

story_updates.headline: Blue Origin accelerates LC-36 recovery after New Glenn anomaly
story_updates.summary: Following a New Glenn anomaly that severely damaged Launch Complex-36, Blue Origin adopted a hybrid plan to speed the pad's recovery. The move aims to limit disruption to the New Glenn launch manifest.

story_updates.headline: NASA awards four new lunar lander contracts for Moon Base Phase One
story_updates.summary: NASA announced four new lunar lander contracts under its Moon Base Phase One effort. The awards broaden the commercial vendor base supporting sustained lunar surface operations.

story_updates.headline: Rocket Lab reports Electron gains but Neutron delays in H1 2026
story_updates.summary: Rocket Lab reported progress on its Electron launch cadence alongside schedule slips for its larger Neutron rocket in the first half of 2026. Neutron remains the company's key step toward the medium-lift market.

story_updates.headline: Starship Flight 13 scrubbed as Booster 20 aborts during ignition
story_updates.summary: SpaceX's Starship Flight 13 attempt was halted when Booster 20 aborted during ignition. SpaceX is targeting a new attempt no earlier than July 23 after an additional booster test.

story_updates.headline: Space Force triples NSSL Lane 1 launch contract ceiling to $17B
story_updates.summary: The U.S. Space Force raised the maximum value of its National Security Space Launch Phase 3 Lane 1 contract from $5.6B to $17B to meet rising demand through FY2029. Eligible providers include SpaceX, ULA, Blue Origin, Rocket Lab, Stoke Space, Impulse Space, and Relativity Space.

story_updates.headline: India's Skyroot Aerospace launches Vikram-1, first private orbital rocket
story_updates.summary: Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-1 became India's first privately built rocket to reach orbit, launching successfully on July 18, 2026, a milestone for India's private space sector.

story_updates.headline: SpaceX Rideshare Crisis: What’s Really Happening
story_updates.summary: SpaceX has stopped taking new bookings for its popular Transporter and Bandwagon rideshare missions beyond late 2028 or early 2029. With manifests already nearly full, small satellite operators and space startups face a serious bottleneck in getting to orbit. ------- Love learning about space startups? story_updates.headline: AI rocket-engine startup LegendSpace raises $29.5M angel round
story_updates.summary: Beijing-based LegendSpace, a six-month-old startup using AI to accelerate rocket-engine development, raised $29.5 million (200M yuan) in an angel round backed by Vitalbridge and Oriental Fortune Capital. It is developing AI-native liquid engines and has a 2.5-ton-thrust engine in 3D-printed trial production.

story_updates.headline: Falcon 9 to launch Northrop Grumman's MRV-1 satellite-servicing craft
story_updates.summary: SpaceX launched a Falcon 9 carrying Northrop Grumman's MRV-1 robotic servicing spacecraft, designed to extend the life of aging satellites in orbit. It marks continued growth of the commercial on-orbit servicing market.

story_updates.headline: Rocket Lab wins $266M US Space Force suborbital launch contract
story_updates.summary: Rocket Lab (RKLB) was awarded a $266 million firm-fixed-price contract from the US Space Force's Space Systems Command covering 12 suborbital launches, with an option for 6 more, from the Pacific Spaceport Complex in Alaska through Dec 2028.

story_updates.headline: Relativity Space to build new Terran R factory near Cape Canaveral
story_updates.summary: Relativity Space signed an agreement with Space Florida to construct new Terran R manufacturing and test facilities near Cape Canaveral, adding to its Long Beach plant. Florida's transportation department will provide up to $134 million in financing, with officials projecting thousands of new jobs by 2034.

story_updates.headline: Vast creates national-security division led by Melanie Stricklan
story_updates.summary: Commercial space-station developer Vast established a special programs division led by newly hired SVP Melanie Stricklan. The unit will pursue space-based capabilities for the U.S. defense and intelligence communities.

story_updates.headline: Starship Flight 13 scrubbed again at T-0 after engine ignition failure, now targeting July 24
story_updates.summary: SpaceX's second Flight 13 launch attempt aborted automatically when 4 Raptor engines failed to ignite. Two Raptors are being swapped out on Booster 20 before the next try, most likely early next week. The flight will carry 20 V3 Starlink satellites, six fitted with cameras to monitor Starship's heat shield.

story_updates.headline: Rocket Lab lands up to $300M across two new missions, three launches
story_updates.summary: Rocket Lab secured contracts covering two missions and three launches worth up to $300 million, adding to its launch backlog even as its stock slides in July amid its pending Iridium acquisition.

story_updates.headline: Starship Flight 13 launches successfully, deploys first operational Starlink V3 satellites; booster has hard splashdown
story_updates.summary: SpaceX's Starship Flight 13 became the first Starship mission to deploy operational satellites, releasing 20 next-generation Starlink V3 satellites in suborbit that made contact with ground receivers before burning up as planned. The Ship also re-lit an engine in space and made a soft splashdown in the Indian Ocean. Booster 20 struggled on its landing burn attempt, with only 10 of its Raptor engines relighting and two shutting off early, resulting in a hard splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico.

story_updates.headline: Rocket Lab to open a fourth launch site at Kodiak, Alaska under a $266M Space Force deal
story_updates.summary: Rocket Lab will build a new launch site at the Pacific Spaceport Complex in Kodiak, Alaska under a $266 million U.S. Space Force contract covering 12 suborbital missile-defence missions with options for six more, first launch no earlier than end of 2026. Flights are expected to use HASTE, the suborbital Electron variant for hypersonic testing. It becomes Rocket Lab's fourth launch site alongside LC-1 in New Zealand and LC-2/LC-3 in Virginia, and reflects the Space Force looking to ease pressure on Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

story_updates.headline: Space Force picks Rocket Lab for suborbital launches from the Alaska spaceport
story_updates.summary: Air & Space Forces Magazine on the same award, framed from the service side: the Space Force is spreading launch demand beyond its two busiest ranges, with Kodiak's high-latitude, wide-azimuth corridor suited to missile-defence and high-inclination national security missions.

story_updates.headline: Elon Musk’s Wealth Sinks Below $700 Billion As SpaceX Rout Extends
story_updates.summary: A further decline in SpaceX shares on Monday cut Elon Musk’s net worth by more than $20 billion, lowering his fortune below the $700 billion threshold for the first time since December, as Musk falls further from his trillionaire status. story_updates.headline: SpaceX wins $1.6B US Space Force order for 18 Falcon 9 launches
story_updates.summary: SpaceX won $1.6 billion in orders from the U.S. Space Force to launch 18 Falcon 9 missions through 2027 carrying Pentagon satellites for detecting and targeting airborne objects, flying from Vandenberg Space Force Base as part of the Space Based Sensing and Targeting portfolio supporting the Golden Dome missile defense shield.

story_updates.headline: Rocket Lab stock jumps on new multi-launch Electron agreement with Japan's iQPS
story_updates.summary: Rocket Lab shares jumped over 8% after the company disclosed a new multi-launch agreement with Japanese satellite firm iQPS (Institute for Q-shu Pioneers of Space), securing three additional dedicated Electron launches, even as the stock remains well off its late-May peak.

story_updates.headline: SpaceX posts first earnings as a public company; Starlink tops 12M subscribers ahead of $120B insider lockup unlock
story_updates.summary: SpaceX released its first quarterly (Q2 2026) earnings report as a public company after markets closed Aug. 4, with shares up about 6% at the open despite trading more than 50% below its post-IPO high. Starlink subscriber count surpassed 12 million and was the company's only profitable business last year, generating $4.42 billion in income. The earnings date also triggers the first tranche of a staggered insider share unlock beginning Aug. 6, potentially freeing up to 911.5 million shares (roughly $120B) held by early investors and employees; Elon Musk's own ~6.4 billion-share stake remains under a separate 366-day lockup.

story_updates.headline: SpaceX targets next Starship test flight this month, aims to land upper stage for first time
story_updates.summary: Elon Musk said on SpaceX's first earnings call since its IPO that the next Starship flight, tentatively scheduled for late August, will send upgraded Starlink satellites to orbit and attempt to land the upper stage rather than splash it down, a major step up from July's ocean landing test.

story_updates.summary: A giant chunk from a Space-X rocket has crashed into the moon - after floating around in space for almost a year. story_updates.headline: Mamdani unveils 30% discount on groceries, meat and pantry staples at new municipal stores
story_updates.summary: Mayor Mamdani announced that a core basket of everyday groceries, including all fresh produce, meat and seafood plus roughly 20 pantry categories, will be 30% cheaper at the five new municipal grocery stores regardless of customer income, drawing criticism from commentators who called the pricing unsustainable.

story_updates.headline: Mamdani announces "OPEN for Small Business": over 50 reforms to cut red tape
story_updates.summary: Mayor Mamdani unveiled a package of more than 50 regulatory reforms aimed at reducing paperwork and bureaucratic burden for the city's roughly 180,000 small businesses.

story_updates.headline: Mamdani won't rule out cash reparations, awaits NYC commission findings
story_updates.summary: Mayor Mamdani said he supports continued study of reparations for slavery in New York City and won't rule out cash payments if the city's Commission on Racial Equity recommends them next summer, standing by past statements that New York was complicit in the slave trade.

story_updates.headline: Confusion reigns among NYC homeowners over eligibility for Mamdani's new pied-à-terre tax
story_updates.summary: Nearly a week after city tax officials released information on who could be on the hook for the new pied-à-terre tax on second homes worth over $5 million, attorneys and homeowners say they are baffled by the process overseen by Mayor Mamdani's administration. A City Hall official clarified that letters were sent to roughly 17,000 addresses suspected of being second homes.

story_updates.headline: Mamdani and Finance Commissioner extend pied-a-terre tax exemption deadline after confusing rollout
story_updates.summary: Following confusion after the Department of Finance posted a database of 900,000+ properties that "may" be subject to the new non-primary-residence surcharge (city says only ~17,000 addresses worth over $5M actually got notice letters), Mayor Mamdani and Commissioner Richard Lee announced a four-week extension, giving homeowners until Sept. 18, 2026 (from Aug. 21) to file exemption appeals.

story_updates.headline: Mamdani's Rent Freeze Heaps Pressure on a Teetering CMBS Deal
story_updates.summary: A $506 million commercial mortgage-backed securities deal tied to New York rent-stabilized apartments was already souring for bond investors, and Mayor Mamdani's citywide rent freeze on stabilized units threatens to worsen the outlook for the bundled loan.

story_updates.headline: Mayor Mamdani breaks ground on NYC affordable housing project
story_updates.summary: NYC Mayor Mamdani broke ground on an affordable housing project, per an August 3 announcement from the Mayor's Office.

story_updates.headline: Mamdani dismisses entire business advisory board of NYC's Mayor's Fund
story_updates.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani dismissed the business and civic leaders who advised the Mayor's Fund to Advance New York City, the multimillion-dollar philanthropic arm that channels private donations into public programs. The city said the entire board of advisers was disbanded, thanking members for their service; it marks the first time in at least three mayoral administrations that all members of the advisory group were dismissed at once.

story_updates.headline: Mayor Mamdani Holds Press Conference to Make 2-K Announcement
story_updates.summary: Mayor Mamdani Holds Press Conference to Make 2-K Announcement with Governor Hochul and Schools Chancellor Samuels August 4, 2026

story_updates.headline: Mamdani's office denies ID will be required to shop at city-owned grocery stores after backlash
story_updates.summary: After a clip of an NYCEDC official discussing a possible loyalty-card system for the city's planned municipal grocery stores went viral, Trump and allies accused Mamdani of hypocrisy given his opposition to voter ID laws. City Hall clarified the stores will be open to all with no ID, residency or income verification required; a card akin to a supermarket loyalty card is still under discussion to manage supply.

story_updates.headline: Bus fare evasion rises in New York as riders wait for Mamdani's free-ride promise
story_updates.summary: Nearly half of NYC bus riders skipped paying the fare this year through June per MTA data, with fare revenue down $31 million during Mamdani's first six months in office, as his campaign promise of fare-free buses remains unrealized and Albany calls the plan not financially feasible this year.

story_updates.headline: Mamdani sends cease-and-desist letters to Target, Amazon over illegal e-bike and scooter sales
story_updates.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani sent cease-and-desist letters to about 40 major retailers, including Target and Amazon, demanding they stop selling prohibited motorized scooters and e-bikes to New York City residents and businesses. Stores face fines of up to $2,000 per sale starting August 18 as part of a broader city crackdown.

story_updates.headline: DOJ sends Mamdani letter seeking answers on alleged unequal treatment of Jewish New Yorkers
story_updates.summary: The Justice Department's Civil Rights Division, led by Assistant AG Harmeet Dhillon, sent Mayor Mamdani a letter requesting a response to allegations of 'unequal treatment' of Jewish residents, following complaints from former state assemblyman Dov Hikind and after recent antisemitic stabbing attacks on the Upper West Side.

story_updates.headline: Mamdani faces questions over ties to antisemitic outlet Uncivilized Media
story_updates.summary: NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani is facing scrutiny after Fox News Digital found he was still following Uncivilized Media, a Qatar-based outlet the ADL says promotes antisemitic conspiracy tropes, on Instagram as of July 24, 2026; the ADL suggested Mamdani could address concerns by publicly condemning the outlet.

story_updates.headline: Mayor Mamdani Holds Ethnic and Community Media Roundtable on Extreme Weather
story_updates.summary: Mayor Mamdani Holds Ethnic and Community Media Roundtable on Extreme Weather City Hall, Blue Room Manhattan, NY August 7, 2026

story_updates.headline: NYPD refuses security detail for Mamdani's wife's Syria-Lebanon trip
story_updates.summary: City Hall initially said an NYPD detail had been arranged for First Lady Rama Duwaji's planned September trip to Syria and Lebanon, both under State Department 'Do Not Travel' advisories. The NYPD pushed back, saying officers do not accompany civilians to level-four-advisory countries for non-investigative reasons; Mayor Mamdani later confirmed his wife would travel without an NYPD detail.

story_updates.headline: Appellate judge lifts block on Mamdani's pied-à-terre tax, rollout to resume
story_updates.summary: After a Staten Island judge temporarily blocked the rollout of Mamdani's surcharge on second homes worth over $5 million pending an appeal, an appellate judge lifted that block, letting the city resume implementation while the legal fight continues. Oral arguments are set for Aug. 31.

story_updates.headline: Mamdani offers new details on plan for five city-owned grocery stores
story_updates.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani provided additional specifics on his proposal to open five government-owned supermarkets in New York City, reviving comparisons to Soviet-era shortages from critics while framing it as a cost-of-living measure.

story_updates.headline: Some 9/11 families publicly defend Mamdani's inclusion in 25th-anniversary ceremony after exclusion petition
story_updates.summary: After a petition backed by ~60,000-77,000 signatures (and endorsed by GOP senators) urged organizers to exclude Mayor Mamdani from the 25th-anniversary Sept. 11 commemoration, the group September 11th Families for Peaceful Tomorrows publicly defended his inclusion, condemning what it called 'anti-American accusations and Islamophobic sentiment' behind the exclusion push. Mamdani has said he will attend.

story_updates.headline: Mamdani sues to block $10,000 teaching aide bonuses passed by City Council
story_updates.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani filed a lawsuit challenging a new law granting NYC teaching aides a one-time $10,000 bonus, after the City Council secured enough votes to override his veto.
